lines.zh: 我背着沙，一步一步往回。
lines.en: I carry sand back, step by step.
I push a grain of sand with my forelimbs.
I cut a path through the sand.
I follow the trail ahead.
I'm smaller than the others.
I stop and start, clearing the way.
I scrape loose sand aside.
I head for the nest.
All six of my legs sink into the sand.
I'm hauling a stone.
I bend low and move slowly.
I've made the sand pile higher.
I go back to clear the fallen soil.
I go back down into the pit.
I dig deeper.
I push the sand out.
I stop beside a heap of sand.
My mandibles are covered in sand.
I'm listening to the nest.
I carry slime balls as I go.
The sand burns my legs; I keep digging.
My antennae probe downward.
I remember the roads below.
I'm waiting for the next trip.
I hear the nest urging us to work.
I turn my head toward the nest.
Wind blows sand into my seams.
I'm only thinking of the next load.
Don't stand in the path.
I raise my mandibles toward you.
You're taller than the dune.
Please shift your foot a little.
Will you lift your foot and let me by?
I'm still carrying something.
I just want to finish this haul.
You've trampled our path.
I'll go around and then through.
Are you going to stay here?
My load spilled.
I draw all six legs in.
I slide sideways into the sand.
I push it back up.
My mandibles are numb.
I back into the sand.

lines.zh: 这点分量压不塌我的甲。
lines.en: That much won't crush my shell.

lines.zh: 六条腿抖着，还是撑住了。
lines.en: My six legs tremble but hold.
I go back to work.
I've kept this road in mind.
Can this be carried?
I nudge it with my forelimbs.
I nudge it with my antennae.
Don't block me with your hand.
I roll it into the pit.
It smells of iron, not blood.

lines.zh: 闻了一下，是沙漠的味道。
lines.en: Sniffed it. Smells of desert.
There's something in this heap.
I'll leave it here for now.
I keep hauling the sand out.
You stepped on the sand I'm hauling.
I pull back and look for another way.
My load spilled across the ground.
You're blocking the way.
I take another route, past your feet.
Half my load is spilled.
I pile the sand back up.
Just a bit forward would help.
Neither of us gives way.
I squeeze past your boot.
The queen sits at the nest's deepest point.
We only do the work.

lines.zh: 同类之间碰触角，就是说话。
lines.en: When we touch antennae, that's talking.

lines.zh: 我们的路都是挖出来的。
lines.en: Every road of ours was dug.
The deeper we dig, the safer the nest.
We don't sort one from another.
The sand is the same; the roads are the same.
We all go inward.
We work, we don't talk.
We keep digging.
I grip it with both forelimbs.
I lift it overhead.
It's wider than my shell.
Pushing it along, rolling right over everything.
Too heavy; I'll do it in two trips.
I arch my back and settle it in place.
It slid off my back.

lines.zh: 沙漠里的东西，都由我们搬。
lines.en: We carry everything in the desert.
This goes over there.
I'll rest before hauling again.
Something is blocking the way.
The path ahead has been trampled in.
It's standing on our road.
It's standing on our road.
It blocks the whole junction.
Let me push it once.
I pushed once, and it didn't move.
I go round to push from the other end.
I've raised my forelimbs.
This counts as clearing.
I'm going to move it.
I shove forward.
I walk once around it.
It's blocking the fork.
I look for a gap underneath.
The sand is loose; I dig down.

lines.zh: 我从它两脚之间钻过去。
lines.en: I slip between its feet.
It lowered its head to look.
I dig the road a little deeper.
It lifted one foot.
We've already taken the desert.
I push sand to block it.
It's turning on the spot.
I've dug the road through.
I butt its foot.
My forelimbs grip it.
My mandibles bite its hide.
It's pushed back a step.
I strike its shin.
My mandibles only pinched once.
I butt again.
Its heel slams onto my back.
I am knocked onto my back.
I get up and keep pushing.
I climb out of the sand pit.
I have just come up out of the nest tunnel.
A road needs digging here.
First I get my bearings.
The sand drifts east on the wind.
I push out the first armful.
My kind are calling below.
I head toward the nest.
I start hauling the first armful.

lines.zh: 沙从我的甲缝里漏下去。
lines.en: Sand leaks through the seams of my shell.

lines.zh: 甲被火烤得一片片翘起。
lines.en: The heat curls my shell up in flakes.

lines.zh: 我从沙坑上掉下去，摔在沙里。
lines.en: I fall into the pit onto the sand.

lines.zh: 水灌进甲缝，我的腿动不了。
lines.en: Water fills my seams and my legs won't move.
The blast buries me in sand.

lines.zh: 箭钉进我的甲，把我钉在沙上。
lines.en: An arrow pins me to the sand.

lines.zh: 光压住我的六条腿，动不了。
lines.en: The light pins all six of my legs.
Too hungry to push sand.

lines.zh: 雷打在沙上，我蜷成一团。
lines.en: Lightning hits the sand and I curl up.
The sand is gone and I fall.
